root: ^Zthara: A visitor from above. A word of advice. Do not disturb the mountains.

c-0: ^Zthara: The peaks above us succumbed to slumber long ago, granting us freedom to roam unshackled. As long as the mountain sleeps, we are free.
c-1: ^Zthara: I'm a Sundered. Since birth, our people have lived in servitude, bound by shackles.
^ By the time freedom arrived, we had grown accustomed to the shadows of these mountains.
